Ack.mapping: One store transaction per ack. CLI nonmatch ack after offer is a separate transaction. Pending match advances watermark; required asks have external handling precondition. Already-acked idempotency omitted.

Adopt.mapping: Atomic adopt event changes root generation. Event ids abstracted to 0 and 1; host and open status fixed.

Crash.mapping: Environment failure loses local response but not committed pending_event_id; a later offer can replay. No dispatch or external-effect recovery claim.

Guard.mapping: Same task and host assumed; claimGen is pinned root session. Plain calls allowed only with no live lease; fenced calls require live binding and equality.

Handle.mapping: Explicit caller assumption outside store: returned required work handled before explicit ack. No implementation claim that the store validates handling.

Init.mapping: Already migrated fresh ledger with one open root; cursor and pending default empty; absent lease represented by holder=0, fence=0. Static inbox from an ordinary unassigned worker is a fixture assumption. Migration preservation is not modeled; v5 work/jobs DDL leaves existing inbox/consumer definitions unchanged.

Offer.mapping: One transaction: guard, lowest id after cursor, got coalesces and clears pending; otherwise offer/replay pending. Only the got coalescing branch is within ASK_ONLY; the remaining coalesce branches concern event kinds outside this policy. Local response observation is a ghost of return value.

RejectAck.mapping: Guard rejection rolls back transaction with no cursor or lease write. Witness state is observer-only.

Release.mapping: One transaction: holding before clearing holder; counter and cursor preserved.

Renew.mapping: One transaction: identify and holding before setting expiry to current time plus TTL.

Take.mapping: One transaction: identify, live refusal unless force, fence increment, binding and expiry write. Advisory wait marker fixed absent. Forced live takeover legal.

Tick.mapping: Abstract wall-clock passage; exclusive expiry. CLI expiry replay requires contract-feature frozen clock.

TransactionBoundary.mapping: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; closure then commit; errors roll back. Channel/composite loops are not atomic.

assumptions: Lease validity is checked at transaction guard linearization, not final wall-clock commit time.
Time advances between atomic modeled transactions; real in-transaction clock passage is not proved.
One open local root, same admitted host; malicious capability sharing is excluded.
A compliant caller handles required asks before ack; store cannot enforce external handling.
Fixed pre-existing got/ready/ask from an ordinary unassigned worker; no active work-owned producer suppression or native route. Work/jobs state machines and migration preservation are excluded.
